reason: My customers find me on Instagram and Facebook, and I already post the specials there myself for free. Paying 25 euros a month for a website nobody looks at, on a margin like mine, makes no sense.
objection: Nobody visits café websites any more, and on top of that it doesn't work with Viber, which is what I actually use all day.
would_change_my_mind: If one message from Viber updated my Instagram, Facebook and Google listing at the same time, so it saved me time instead of adding another thing to feed.
